refs: From the number of these officers being thirty-seven, it is almost self-evident that shalishim cannot denote the thirty, as rendered in 2Sa 24:13 , etc., but some particular description of men, or officers
for it can scarcely be said, with propriety, that we have thirty-seven out of thirty
and besides, in the parallel place in 1Chronicles, there are sixteen added!
